name: filter-bar-layouts
tagline: Eleven list-filter layouts from leading products, all FilterBar + existing primitives: (a) inline packed, (b) search-first + ONE Filter menu + chips, (c) promoted + More-filters Sheet, (d) saved views above the bar, (e) wide search then filters, (f) actions at the end + sticky, (g) faceted sidebar, (h) compact bar in a table card, (i) date range + quick ranges, (j) phone stack + Sheet, (k) docked side panel. Filters always pack at the START.
